The '''Fei Hu sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located within the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].

==History==
The sector was the site of the [[Fei Hu campaign]] early in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="TEGTW" />
